description: Template submission for the odd cycle game C_3, shipping the per-question counts behind the result so the win rate is recomputed rather than trusted. Replace every value with the real run.

nonlocalGame.uncertaintyDefinition: 95% confidence half-width (d = 0.05) over the 6 per-question win rates at 1024 shots each, using the calculate_ci definition of Furches et al., Quantum Sci. Technol. 10, 045002 (2025), doi 10.1088/2058-9565/adf1c0

notes: The classical value of C_3 is 1 - 1/(2n) = 5/6 = 0.8333333333333334. The counts in counts.json give 0.8059895833333334, which is below it, so this template does not claim quantum advantage.
